markAsComplete.description: Whether to mark the asset's sensor mapping status as complete.

title:
Spec to modify the sensor mappings of a {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

This spec is used to create new {@link Sensor}s, create new {@link ExpectedSensor}s, upsert {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s,
remove sensor relations, and mark the asset's sensor mapping status as complete.
name: ModifySensorMappingSpec
